per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should run on any server where the Java runtime can be installed, supporting Linux, Windows, and Solaris operating systems.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with existing web or application servers such as Tomcat or JBoss.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with various database management systems including Postgres, Oracle, and SQL Server.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must work with most database management systems (DBMS) on the market whether the DBMS is colocated with the product on the same machine or is located on a different machine on the computer network.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should feel instant for small actions and should not take more than five seconds for routine tasks.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle at least one thousand simultaneous requests today and double that by the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should aim for 99.99% uptime excluding server-level failures.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Only company employees or explicitly approved external users should be able to log in, with authentication tied to corporate identity systems like LDAP or SAML.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should sanitize inputs, validate everything server-side, and prevent malicious input from corrupting data stores or adjacent systems.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide guarantees that malicious input will not result in corrupted product data.
